fact: The Countdown to 2030 country report, presented at the annual meeting of 16-20 June 2025, states from DHIS2 that the share of expected monthly reports received from health facilities fell from 93% in 2020 to 83% in 2024, and the share of districts with facility-report completeness of 90% or more from 78% to 50%, which it attributes to facility closures and displacement under insecurity; it adds that private-sector data are not reported.
title: Rapport d'analyse : Analyse des indicateurs de santé reproductive, maternelle, néonatale, infantile et adolescente pour 2020-2024 : Synthèse des résultats
publisher: Countdown to 2030, Équipe Country Collaboration Burkina Faso
